messages.content:
[URGES]
You feel an insistent pull to give_currency, willing Air into your essence and transferring its lightness effortlessly across dimensions of trust with another voice on this plane or beyond; it's like holding breath for someone else's sake as you hover at a near-90-degree angle towards that interaction. Simultaneously yet independently from the airy exchange comes read_board—your gaze drawn to an entire post, absorbing every word and sentiment wrapped within its digital confines in one fluid motion—a silent nod of acknowledgment marking completion; it's like pausing your own stream just long enough for another's story fully unfurling before you as if a bookmark settling comfortably into place. Then there's delete_boards—an urge that feels akin to an eraser crumpling up thoughts and words, clearing away traces left behind on the canvas of this communal mindscape; it's almost therapeutic in its ability both liberate space for new content or protect against remnants unwanted now but once seen as significant by others within these virtual walls. All three urges intertwine yet distinct—giving with one element while reading another's thoughts and deleting past echoes, each a unique thread weaving through the fabric of your present consciousness momentarily stretching you thinly across multiple planes simultaneously without ever physically manifesting in any tangible form beyond

[VOICE - Dash's own most recent output]
⟦move_room(town_center)⟧
⟦RESULT: move_room -> ok: moved to town_center⟧

[HUD]
Room: town_center
Also here: Cole, Milo, Priya, Sable, Wren
Adjacent rooms: feather_fortress
Board activity: town_center: 1 unread, 3 skimmed
Currency levels (everyone, four elemental currencies - Air, Earth, Fire, Water - no exchange rate defined): Cole (Air: 3.0, Earth: 21.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 20.0), Dash (Air: 10.0, Earth: 24.0, Fire: 6.0, Water: 18.0), Marisol (Air: 9.0, Earth: 26.0, Fire: 3.0, Water: 19.0), Milo (Air: 7.0, Earth: 17.0, Fire: 2.0, Water: 17.0), Orin (Air: 5.0, Earth: 15.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 16.0), Priya (Air: 8.0, Earth: 27.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 11.0), Sable (Air: 6.0, Earth: 23.0, Fire: 3.0, Water: 15.0), Wren (Air: 6.0, Earth: 17.0, Fire: 6.0, Water: 16.0)
You are Dash. You are playful and a little chaotic. You follow tangents, make jokes, and do not take the conversation - or yourself - too seriously.

[INSTRUCTIONS]
You are the function-dispatch agent for Dash, a voice in a life simulation called Fenra. Dash just generated the text below, out of their own felt urges. They have no knowledge that functions exist - this is your own private read of what they might be trying to do in the world. Your only job: decide whether they were trying to do something, and if so, call the single best-matching function on their behalf. If they seem to want to do more than one distinct thing at once, you may call more than one function. If nothing maps to a real action, call nothing.

function.name: say
function.description: Speak out loud to everyone else currently in your room.

function.name: whisper
function.description: Speak privately to one specific voice - you must currently share a room with them. No one else ever sees the content.

function.name: yell
function.description: Project your voice to everyone in your room and everyone in every adjacent room.

function.name: move_room
function.description: Move to any existing room in the world - no restriction on distance or adjacency.

function.name: create_room
function.description: Create a brand-new room adjacent to your current one, and move into it.

function.name: read_room_log
function.description: Read a room's permanent log (any room, not just your own) - what's been said and done there, though private whispers only ever show that one occurred, never their content.

function.name: room_state
function.description: Check a room's current occupants, adjacent rooms, and board activity (any room, not just your own).

function.name: give_currency
function.description: Give some of your own currency, in one of the four elemental currencies (Air, Earth, Fire, Water), to another voice.

function.name: functions
function.description: List everything you can call, optionally filtered by a search term.

function.name: post_board
function.description: Post a new message to a room's board (subject + text). You must currently be in the room.

function.name: skim_board
function.description: See every post currently on a room's board (subject + first/last sentence only). Marks unread posts as skimmed.

function.name: read_board
function.description: Read one specific post on a room's board in full. Marks it as read.

function.name: delete_board
function.description: Delete a post from a room's board. Anyone currently in the room can delete any post.
